\begin{itemchoice}
			\itemch Ta có $\left|\vec{A'C}\right| = A'C = \sqrt{AB^2 + AD^2 + AA'^2} = \sqrt{a^2 + a^2 + a^2} = a\sqrt{3}$.\\
			\itemch Ta có $\vec{AB} = \vec{DC}$, do đó $\vec{AB} = \vec{CD}$ là sai.\\
			\itemch Ta có $\vec{AB} \cdot \vec{B'C'} = \vec{AB} \cdot \vec{BC} = 0$ vì $AB \perp BC$.\\
			\itemch Ta có $\vec{AN} = \vec{AC'} + \vec{C'N} = \vec{AA'} + \vec{AB} + \vec{AD} + \displaystyle \frac{2}{3}\vec{C'B'}$.\\
			Mà $\vec{C'B'} = \vec{DA} = -\vec{AD}$ nên $\vec{AN} = \vec{AA'} + \vec{AB} + \vec{AD} - \displaystyle \frac{2}{3}\vec{AD} = \vec{AA'} + \vec{AB} + \frac{1}{3}\vec{AD}$.
		\end{itemchoice}
